result:
Only the new file was added; the pre-existing deletion of `BitFieldTest.java` was already there before I started (not something I touched).

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/BitFieldAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (no base class, matching the project's Jupiter style) with 35 tests covering all public `BitField` methods: both `int`/`long` constructors, `clear`/`clearByte`/`clearShort`, `getRawValue`/`getShortRawValue`, `getValue`/`getShortValue`, `isSet`/`isAllSet`, `set`/`setByte`/`setShort`, the `*Boolean` setters, and `setValue`/`setShortValue`. It covers boundary cases (zero mask, full `-1` mask, top-bit masks for both `int` and `long` verifying the sign-extension fix in `getValue`), cross-width behavior (int-constructed mask applied to long holders), and the javadoc's paint-instruction example as an integration check. Verified with `mvn test -Dtest=BitFieldAgentTest` — all 35 tests pass.
